cameras.name: camera
cameras.evidence: Height 135 mm measured by user; pitch from straight-lane vanishing point within measured 30-35 deg. Intrinsics reproduce local camera_ros undistortion/ROI/resize in the bag. Forward offset and yaw retained from the original simulation; not independently measured.

cameras.evidence: Temporary simulation-only 80 deg horizontal FOV workaround requested 2026-11-11 after intersection visibility diagnosis. Both focal lengths scaled equally to preserve image proportions. Mount pose remains provisional from lidar height/right-side mounting and bag framing; these intrinsics are not measured hardware calibration.

previous_bag_estimate.evidence: Provisional: user reports lidar height and right-side mounting.
